text:
jakob: heads up — saw ~1k grpc streaming failures in prod-usw last night starting ~19:00 UTC. clients report 'unexpected EOF' and parse errors.
revathi: same. correlates with GPU autoscale events — new inference pods added around 19:01. backends logged mid-stream FINs.
david: quick hypothesis: ALB is doing h2 multiplex to backends, our sidecar pools connections. If backend half-closes a stream but keeps conn open, we may be seeing partial frames from previous streams interleaved.
mike: I captured tcpdump on a pod. here's a trimmed hexdump of two consecutive DATA frames that look... wrong:
```
0000: 00 00 08 01 00 00 00 00  64 6f 6e 65 2e 2e 2e 0a
0008: 00 00 04 00 00 00 00 01  5b 70 72 6f 63 5d 0a
```
revathi: interesting — looks like two payloads glued. envoy sidecar (v2.3.1) was deployed right before the spike (deploy-bot: inference-sidecar v2.3.1 at 19:01).
deploy-bot: inference-sidecar v2.3.1 rolled in namespace inference-prod at 2026-03-18T19:01:02Z
david: repro steps: long-lived streaming RPC + backend writes final chunk then does `shutdown(SHUT_WR)` while keeping socket; envoy treats connection as healthy and reuses it for new stream -> frames overlap. Possibly an http2 frame-parsing bug.
revathi: quick mitigation: disable h2 multiplexing at ALB -> backend (force single stream per conn) or set sidecar to `max_concurrent_streams: 1`. Can we flip ALB to `connection: close` for that target group?
jakob: doing a targeted config change: adding header rewrite to injection filter for inference target group to set `connection: close` for now. will monitor.
sre-oncall: increased 5xx rate back to normal after config change at ~19:18 UTC. rolling back if no issues.
mike: +1 for a proper fix — looks like envoy http2 mux race. filing issue with repro and attaching pcap. tagging eng-runtime.
revathi: next steps: 1) create minimal repro harness that opens two streams quickly and forces backend half-close 2) run against envoy v2.3.2 (candidate fix) 3) if confirmed, roll to prod with canary 5% -> 50%.
jakob: noted. I'll handle the ALB rule rollback after we validate canary.
mike: attaching pcap to the ticket: link: https://internal.aws/pcap/2012345678-stream-interleave.pcap
revathi: thanks all :thumbsup:
